title: WebSocket: specify extensions
body:
From https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/840#discussion_r55681764

> I see `Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; client_max_window_bits` as a request header in Opera, and `.extensions` returns "permessage-deflate" (this is inspecting with Packet Peeper when running a websocket test with wpt-serve on localhost).
> 
> ```
> GET /echo HTTP/1.1
> Host: web-platform.test:55941
> Connection: Upgrade
> Pragma: no-cache
> Cache-Control: no-cache
> Upgrade: websocket
> Origin: http://localhost:8000
> Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
> User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_11_3) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/49.0.2623.23 Safari/537.36 OPR/36.0.2130.2 (Edition beta)
> Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, lzma, sdch
> Accept-Language: sv,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.6
> Sec-WebSocket-Key: If6o1XtBFJFCOjpx801n3w==
> Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; client_max_window_bits
> 
> HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols
> Upgrade: websocket
> Connection: Upgrade
> Sec-WebSocket-Accept: oqdG/tyYop2FvC++CnYrC3uXVDU=
> Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate
> 
> ..>("...
> ```

Same thing in Chrome canary.

WebKit:

```
GET /echo HTTP/1.1
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Host: web-platform.test:55941
Origin: http://localhost:8000
Pragma: no-cache
Cache-Control: no-cache
Sec-WebSocket-Key: crda+fH2MDdI0BafoawOTQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: x-webkit-deflate-frame
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_11_3) AppleWebKit/602.1.20+ (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/9.0.3 Safari/601.4.4

HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Accept: dwX5uxB9tidGXjxIzsyxtOmShWs=
Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: x-webkit-deflate-frame

.../........
```

`.extensions` returns "x-webkit-deflate-frame" 

Gecko:

```
GET /echo HTTP/1.1
Host: web-platform.test:55941
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.11; rv:47.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/47.0
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8
Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.5
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Origin: http://localhost:8000
Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate
Sec-WebSocket-Key: WqZ/bFzXtm4c23mbyU0ocA==
Connection: keep-alive, Upgrade
Pragma: no-cache
Cache-Control: no-cache
Upgrade: websocket

HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Accept: foUll0bQDfhsLs2Ws0cntMb73lo=
Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate

............
```

`.extensions` returns "permessage-deflate"
